---
name: "Bug report / 问题反馈"
about: "Report a reproducible problem with a Skill, runner or installation."
title: "[Bug] "
labels: bug
---

## Before posting / 提交前

- [ ] I searched existing issues and Discussions.
- [ ] I removed API keys, tokens, account details, private research and personal paths.
- [ ] I will not repeat a potentially charged request just to produce a reproduction.

## Package and environment / 技能与环境

Skill ID, installed commit, AI client/version, OS, Python and installer versions:

## Expected and actual behavior / 预期与实际

What should happen? What actually happened?

## Minimal reproduction / 最小复现

Use synthetic inputs or permission-cleared public material. Include redacted commands and the error category, not a full private log. If it cannot be safely reproduced, say so.

## Evidence and scope / 证据与边界

Is this an installation issue, a reference method, a public read or an account-backed request? Label fixtures versus actual observations. Do not post billing or identity details; use private account support for those.
